_note: Hand-authored fragment edits, replayed idempotently by every build (python -m biblecore retrofit). Ops: strip_span, text, untag_word, retag_word, unwrap, retag, add. retro-tags.json beside this file is generated by the porter; don't hand-edit it.

retag._c: data-w for spans data-w can't align on its own: English splits one Greek verb around its object ('hand y'all over'), so the author tagged both halves and both point at the one Greek word. from == to: only data-w is injected, the root is unchanged.

text._c: Tracked spans outside the verse text (legend rows, ring labels, glosses, tables) become class="rl": same colour, root-linked but uncounted, so they need no data-w (style reference: 'class=rl for a root-linked mention that shouldn't be counted as an occurrence').

The Lord's Prayer is a set piece (div.prayer), not verse-by-verse text: declare its verses so its tracked spans are summary tags and the audit reports 6:9-13 as covered, as Numbers does for its census tables.
1:1 and 1:20 are the title 'son of David', not just the name: the thread's phrase span replaces the local `david` span there (lineage mentions elsewhere, e.g. 1:6, stay local).
